name: ShutterBase
summary:
# Your darkroom, wherever you shoot
Turn your Meta Quest into a portable photo studio. Import your shots, edit on a large, glare-free screen, and prepare client proofs before you pack up.

# Bring your camera
Open RAW files from Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm and more, plus JPEG, HEIC, TIFF and PNG. Import from a camera or card reader over USB-C, open files on headset storage, or send photos from your phone or computer over Wi-Fi with Local Access.
